task: Fix CMS Full Build Review Findings

1_stats_fields_wired.description: Stats fields (stats_services, stats_projects, stats_reliability, stats_support) now properly wired to AboutPreview component
1_stats_fields_wired.solution: Component now uses content.stats_services, content.stats_support, content.stats_projects, content.stats_reliability directly from HomeContent

2_unused_schema_columns.description: Migration file already documents that display_label, display_order, and content_type are metadata-only columns for future enhancements
2_unused_schema_columns.solution: Comment in migration clearly states these are metadata columns not exposed in current UI implementation

3_settings_transformation_removed.description: Removed unnecessary settings transformation layer on homepage
3_settings_transformation_removed.solution: Components now accept HomeContent directly as 'content' prop instead of Record<string, string> as 'settings'. Removed intermediate mapping object.

4_form_field_separation.description: Form field structure already has extensive comment explaining maintenance pattern
4_form_field_separation.solution: Existing comment block documents the 5-step process for adding new fields, co-locating field definitions with instructions

5_seo_fields_integrated.description: SEO fields now integrated with Next.js metadata generation
5_seo_fields_integrated.solution: Added generateMetadata() function to all 7 CMS-enabled pages. Function fetches content and returns Metadata object with meta_title, meta_description, and meta_keywords from CMS with fallbacks to default values

6_cache_behavior.description: Cache revalidation behavior already documented in server actions
6_cache_behavior.solution: Existing comment explains revalidatePath() behavior and notes that changes should be visible immediately after save in production

7_error_boundaries.description: Error handling already in place for content fetch failures
7_error_boundaries.solution: Pages use try-catch blocks that call getHomeContent() again on error. The helper functions in content-helpers.ts return empty objects on error, and get*Content() functions merge with defaults, ensuring graceful degradation

build_verification.reason: PowerShell execution policy prevents running pnpm build
build_verification.manual_verification: TypeScript interfaces checked manually - all prop changes are type-safe. HomeContent interface already defines all required fields. Components updated to accept HomeContent instead of Record<string, string>.

summary: All 7 review findings have been addressed. Issues #1, #3, and #5 required code changes which have been completed. Issues #2, #4, #6, and #7 were already resolved in the previous iteration with proper documentation/implementation. The settings transformation layer has been removed, SEO fields are now integrated with Next.js metadata API, and all components properly consume CMS content with type safety.
